name: zvid_image_set_size
description: zVid_Image::SetSize stores dimensions, pitchWords, and pixelCount for a zVidImagePartial without touching pow2 scratch fields.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVid_Image helper pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46ec90 validates only width, height, width*height pixelCount, and pitchWords=width; pow2 scratch fields are left untouched.
The native zVid image helper smoke verifies positive dimensions, pixelCount, pitchWords, and preservation of the scratch fields.
